source: WHO Child Growth Standards (2006): Length/height-for-age — L, M, S parameters as distributed in WHO's official Anthro software (R package 'anthro' by the World Health Organization, data-raw/growthstandards/lenanthro.txt)
notes: Age in days and L, M, S copied verbatim from WHO's official Anthro reference data (lenanthro.txt). No unit conversion applied. L = 1 for every row (as published by WHO for length/height-for-age). Rows split on the published length/height measurement transition (loh column): length = days 0-730 (measured recumbent, < 24 mo), height = days 731-1826 (measured standing, >= 24 mo). Values cross-checked against the WHO2006 LMS rows published by RCPCH (rcpch/growth-references, uk-who/UK_WHO_0_20_preterm.csv): agreement within age-mapping precision, including the ~0.7 cm length-to-height discontinuity at the 24-month transition.
